g.text: UC-02 Upload .md material -> generate & approve AI questions
UC-03 Build exam paper & schedule sessions
UC-05 Take the exam & record answers
UC-06 AI transcribes speech & grades by rubric
GRADING ERROR - FAILED, examiner grades manually or re-grades
UC-07 Persist result PENDING_REVIEW + audit log
UC-08 Review evidence & assign the official score
PUBLISH ERROR - 409, review again then publish
UC-09 Handle incident: re-grade one answer / grant retake
